title: Quick Fix Turkish Wagyu Kebabs
description: A quick-fix Turkish dish featuring Wagyu beef, resting meat, and a sweet glaze that's sugar-free friendly.

ingredients.name: resting meat
ingredients.notes: such as lamb, beef, or turkey

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, around 400°F (200°C).
Thread the Wagyu beef and resting meat onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the sweet paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and sprinkle with the spice mixture.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While the skewers are cooking, mix together the brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
After 8 minutes, brush the skewers with the sweet glaze and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the grill and garnish with chopped parsley.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
